Our Story

Where Every Gift Tells a Story

"You will receive unparalleled service and detail in your personal basket."

Founded in 2010 in the heart of New York, Absolutely Fabulous by June was born from a deep passion for creating meaningful connections through thoughtful gifting. What started as a love for beautiful presentation has grown into one of New York's most celebrated custom gift basket and event planning studios — earning June award recognition for her extraordinary craft.

As a certified gift specialist, June personally handcrafts every basket in her studio with meticulous care. She brings the same warmth and joy she pours into her family and community into every ribbon tied and every gift wrapped — so your recipients feel truly, genuinely celebrated.
